standard: Field Assembly Record Standard 1.2, §8 market records; see PROVENANCE.md
notes: Draft. Numbers computed 2026-11-16 from run 2026-11-13T230637Z. Prose drafted 2026-11-16 by a session from numbers.md and numbers.json, modeled on Issue 1; not yet reviewed, not signed. Before writing, the drafter recalculated the headline figures from the captured files of the issue run, not from numbers.json, and all matched numbers.json: the six report 3649 weighted averages and pounds for the block 10/5/2026 to 10/30/2026 (report dated November 3, 2026), their prior-month values against both the November 3 report's 'Previous Months Trading' columns and the retained October 2 report, and the six month-over-month changes; both PPI values with their October 2025 and October 2024 changes; the CPI and average-price values and two-year changes; the three ERS composites, with the spread equal to retail less wholesale; the slaughter head, live weight, year-ago and year-to-date figures and the four classes summing to the total; the Food Price Outlook rows. The national composite whole bird's pounds equal WOG plus whole-body composites and its price is their pound-weighted average in the November 3 report. The BLS footnote 'Data unavailable due to the 2025 lapse in appropriations' was read in the retained series.json on October 2025 for CUUR0000SEFF01, CUUR0000SEFV, APU0000706111, APU0000FF1101 and APU0000706212; both WPU series have an October 2025 value. tools/check.py passes (173 figures). evidence.json was checked, not edited: it lists the issue run's seven files and the report 3649 and slaughter captures of the ten earlier runs, which covers the September block (report of October 2) behind the month-over-month comparison and the nine slaughter weeks; 2026-09-23T150831Z holds only a BLS capture and is rightly absent. Known limits stated in the text: no year-over-year for report 3649 until the August 2027 block; no October 2025 value for five BLS series; whole bird delivered, every parts row FOB; bone-in thighs the thinnest row; no thigh figure and no price range quoted (the November 3 report prints no implausible range; the October 2 misprint is mentioned without its figures); the report spells out neither 'B/S' nor 'WOG'; slaughter preliminary with an undated comparable week; October PPIs preliminary. Bare counts and worded quantities checked by hand against the captures, since the gate reads none of them: four-week October block (Monday October 5 to Friday October 30) and five-week September block; nine slaughter weeks held and eight before the latest; ten earlier runs listed by id; six rows, of which four fell (three by less than 1%) and two rose; eleven rows without a year-earlier figure (five BLS, six report 3649); six kinds of measure; 'both thigh averages rose' (both rows show a positive change in the November 3 report); the bone-in thigh row the fewest pounds of any row; report dates November 3, November 12 (a Thursday), October 23 (Food Price Outlook 'Last Updated' on the retained landing page) and November 13 (report 2740). For the editor: (1) BLS revised September 2026 WPU0141 from 311.036 (every capture through 2026-11-06, and Issue 1's 311.0 and -5.0%) to 327.406 in this run, against 327.465 for September 2025, so Issue 1's year-over-year fall for that index is about nil on the revised value; WPU022203 September moved from 185.461 to 185.419. The revised values are not in numbers.json, so the text describes the revision in words only, in the uncertainty section and the corrections line; decide whether Issue 1 needs an appended note and whether issue.py should carry the revised prior month. (2) The slaughter chicken PPI's +10.4% rests on a low October 2025 (296.897, against 327.465 in September 2025); the text says so in words without the figures and infers no cause. (3) Month-over-month for the BLS and ERS series is not in the computed set, so the issue does not compare October with the September figures Issue 1 printed. (4) Thigh rows are still outside the computed set; the text says only that both averages rose. (5) The Next issue line carries no date because no retained capture states the BLS release date; the Food Price Outlook landing page gives its own next update only. (6) methodology.md gives report 3649's cadence as 'first business day'; this report is dated Tuesday November 3, the second business day of the month. (7) The sentence 'The revision to September's is the size such a revision can be' is the drafter's wording and may be cut. (8) BLS series titles and the PPI import exclusion rest on sources.json and BLS definitions, not on a retained file, as in Issue 1. Status stays draft; only the editor sets published, a version or a reviewer line. Independent review 2026-11-16 (a separate session pass that recalculated every headline figure, date and weekday from the captures; all matched numbers.json; all 27 evidence.json hashes re-checked). Applied: the read now says the one retail measure with a year-earlier value is an ERS composite, and the explanation states that ERS's file gives the retail composite an October 2025 value (244.5) while marking the three BLS chicken retail prices for that month NA, so the retail and spread comparisons rest on a year-earlier value this record cannot trace; 'the comparison will not appear later' replaced with what the retained file shows; 'last days of August' made 'last day' (the September block starts Monday, August 31); the base-effect sentence now names both producer price indexes and the ERS wholesale composite; 'five retail series' made 'five BLS consumer series'; the sentence generalizing from the September revision cut; year-to-date table labels matched to Issue 1; the record section now says where the superseded September producer price value is retained, because evidence.json lists BLS only for the issue run. Left for the editor: the heading quote 'Domestic - Fresh - Conventional' extracts from the PDF as '... - Delivered' for the whole bird and 'Domestic - Fresh- Conventional - FOB' for parts (Issue 1 and methodology.md carry the same quote; look at the PDF); whether Issue 1 gets an appended note for the BLS revision of September WPU0141 (311.036 to 327.406; its printed -5.0% is about nil on the revised value), which methodology.md's corrections rule appears to call for; methodology.md's 'first business day' cadence against a report dated Tuesday, November 3. The editor read and signed the result on 2026-11-16 and directed publication of all five November titles the same day.
